Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Prabhakar Joshi, learned legal-aid 
counsel for the appellant.
2. Mr. J.S. Virk, learned D.A.G. along with 
Mr. Rakesh Joshi, learned Brief Holder for the 
State of Uttarakhand.
3. This is an appeal against conviction filed 
by the appellant under Section 374(2) of 
Cr.P.C. By the impugned judgment dated 
14.05.2024 passed by learned F.T.C./ 
Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge 
(POCSO), Udham Singh Nagar in Special 
Sessions Trial No.163 of 2021, appellant was 
convicted for offence punishable under 
Sections 376(3), 504, 506 IPC and Section 
5(m)/6 of the Protection of Children from 
Sexual Offences Act (POCSO), 2012, vide and
was sentenced to 20 years’ rigorous 
imprisonment with fine of Rs.30,000/-.
4. As per office report, appeal is within 
time.
5. Admit the appeal.
6. Let trial court record be summoned.
7. List on 24.09.2024.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
 13.06.2024
PN
